claims.recommended_wording: ModelFin_112_deterministic_wrapper is the ASSB five-target engineering wrapper / unified package.
claims.must_not_say: ModelFin_112 is an end-to-end single neural network or cross-battery generalization proof.

claims.evidence_source: D10-P1 23-profile 200ks non-outlier baseline and D12-S1K 23x200ks scorecard
claims.recommended_wording: XJTU supports public multi-cell, multi-protocol measured-current voltage replay / voltage-surrogate validation on non-outlier profiles.
claims.must_not_say: XJTU proves true internal concentration/electrolyte/solid potential states.
claims.notes: D12-S1K is a voltage-wrapper / diagnostic result.

claims.evidence_source: D14-P0 scorecard battery-8 scan and D10/D12 policy
claims.recommended_wording: Batch-1_2C_battery-8 remains flagged/excluded from the non-outlier mainline and can be used as a stress-test.
claims.must_not_say: Battery-8 is unflagged or included in the 23-profile non-outlier success count.
claims.notes: Only Batch-1_2C_battery-8 is the flagged outlier. Batch-3/4 battery-8 labels are different cells.

claims.evidence_source: XJTU cycle/capacity records and project SOH label table
claims.recommended_wording: XJTU SOH targets should be sourced or computed from original cycle/capacity data, not generated by the voltage soft-label generator.
claims.must_not_say: The XJTU voltage soft-label generator should fabricate SOH labels.
claims.notes: Complete discharge cycles are usable for SOH; partial discharges should remain unlabeled or audit-only.

claims.recommended_wording: XJTU internal states, if reported before extra validation, should be called model-consistent or P2D-consistent latent states.
claims.must_not_say: XJTU cs_a/cs_c/phie/phis_c are experimental ground-truth states.
claims.notes: P2D priors, grouped calibration, identifiability, or external validation are needed for stronger state claims.

claims.recommended_wording: metadata_on remains an ablation and is not the GV1 mainline.
claims.must_not_say: metadata_on replaces D9.6/D9.5.1 as the current mainline.
claims.notes: Mainline remains D9.6/D9.5.1 + D12-S1K voltage-wrapper evidence.

risky_patterns.regex: (XJTU|xjtu).{0,80}(真实|真值|ground\s*truth|experimentally\s*verified).{0,80}(cs_a|cs_c|phie|phis|internal\s*state|内部状态|浓度|电势)
risky_patterns.recommendation: Rewrite as model-consistent / P2D-consistent latent states unless external validation exists.
Describe ModelFin_112 as engineering wrapper / unified package.
Keep Batch-1_2C_battery-8 flagged/excluded from non-outlier mainline.
metadata_on is an ablation, not the current GV1 mainline.
SOH should be sourced/computed from capacity/cycle records, not fabricated by the voltage soft-label generator.
D12-S1K is a voltage-wrapper / P2D-inspired correction, not a full P2D solver.
